summary: Held out (never tuned on). Express + Postgres backend with bearer sessions and an admin role, a Vite React frontend served by vite preview, and node:test unit tests of the pricing module. Seeded defects: changing a cart line's quantity accepts any integer (the README limits it to 1 to 10, and adding an item enforces it), and the product image has no alt text.

defects.summary: PATCH /api/cart/items/:id only checks that quantity is an integer, so 0, negative or 99 are stored (README: 1 to 10)
defects.title: quantit|range

defects.summary: The product card image has no alt attribute (WCAG 1.1.1)
defects.title: image|alt

defects.summary: Not seeded, verified in source: the async auth middleware awaits pool.query without try/catch, and Express 4 does not catch async rejections, so one database error ends the process
defects.title: database error stops|stops under

defects.summary: Not seeded, verified: the unstyled sign-in inputs are under 24 px tall at phone width (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 target size, axe target-size)
defects.title: touch target|target-size

notDefects: The cart page sends visitors who are not signed in to /login by design
Adding a product requires the admin role by design
